# Short
As developers become architects of correctness (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47115067), agents get dedicated browser automation (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46252251) and ephemeral VM sandboxes (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45649397).

# Long
As AI agents take over writing the code between input and output, developers must shift from craftsmen to architects of correctness whose primary artifact is defining "done" (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=47115067). That shift relies on dedicated agent infrastructure, such as coroutine-safe browser automation built on the Chrome DevTools Protocol (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=46252251) and ephemeral VM sandboxes exposed through the Model Context Protocol (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45649397).
